name: AI Product Tools – Bulk Product Content Generator & AI Toolkit for WooCommerce
author: Dogu Pekgoz

sections.description:
AI Product Tools is a comprehensive AI suite designed to automate your WooCommerce operations and enhance customer experience. It combines high-volume bulk product content generation with a store-aware AI Shop Assistant, providing a complete infrastructure for both backend management and frontend sales support.

The plugin offers versatile workflows to suit any store management style:
* AI Bulk Product Content Generators: Trigger mass updates for Descriptions, Titles, Tags, Taxonomies, FAQs, and Image Alt Text.
* AI Bulk SEO Meta Generator: Support your search visibility with AI-generated Meta Titles & Descriptions compatible with major SEO plugins.
* AI Shop Assistant (Chatbot): A 24/7 intelligent sales agent that uses your catalog and store policies to assist visitors.
* Automation Jobs: Schedule automated background tasks (“set and forget”).
* Single Product Metabox: Fine-tune content directly inside the WooCommerce edit screen.
* Visual Prompt Builder: Stop guessing how to write prompts. Build them visually step-by-step with a real-time preview of your configuration.

It integrates seamlessly with leading AI providers, giving you full control over model selection (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, OpenRouter), prompts, and generation strategies. Supports centralized API credential management via WordPress AI Connectors.

🤖 Key Features

  • WordPress AI Connectors Integration (New): Connect via the native WordPress AI Connectors system. Manage provider credentials centrally instead of storing them locally within the plugin, featuring a live status panel and guided migration.
  • AI Bulk Image Alt Generator (New): Scan and generate context-aware alt text for product images. Review, edit, regenerate, or dismiss before applying changes.
  • Dashboard Insights (New): High-level dashboard cards tracking recent automation activity, exact usage statistics, and real-time AI provider connectivity status.
  • Searchable Command Palette (New): Instantly navigate through complex provider settings, prompt hubs, and feature configurations inside the Settings panel.
  • WordPress 7.0 Abilities API & MCP Support: Fully compatible with WordPress 7.0 core abilities and Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients for native tool-calling automation.
  • AI Shop Assistant: An intelligent chatbot with a mobile-first tabbed interface that answers queries, recommends products, and integrates with WhatsApp.
  • AI Bulk SEO Generator: Generate optimized Meta Titles & Descriptions for Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO, and more.
  • Smart FAQ Display System: Automatically display generated FAQs on product pages with customizable themes, accordion animations, and built-in SEO Schema markup.
  • Resilient Generation & Retry: Never restart a bulk job due to a single error. Easily retry failed generations on a per-product basis with one click.
  • Prompt Management: Create, save, and reuse custom Prompt Templates, or discover and import optimized prompts from the Community Prompt Library (Pro).
  • AI Brand Voice: Define your store’s persona and tone settings globally to ensure the AI writes in your brand’s unique voice.
  • Example Content Learning: Paste an example of your preferred product description, and the AI will mimic its structure and style (Pro).
  • Unified AI Dashboard: Centralized control center featuring new Dashboard Insights (recent activity, usage stats) to manage all generation tools.
  • Mass Product Content Generation: Bulk process Descriptions, Titles, Tags, Taxonomies, FAQs, Image Alt Text, and SEO Metadata for thousands of products.
  • Multi-Provider Support: Connect with leading AI models including OpenAI (GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-4.1, O3/O4), Google Gemini (3.5 Flash, 3.1 Pro, 2.5), Anthropic Claude (Opus 4.7, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5), and OpenRouter (300+ models).
  • Smart Context Analysis: The AI analyzes product categories, attributes, prices, and stock status to create factual, relevant content.
  • SEO & HTML Formatting: Automatically structures content with HTML markup and keywords. Includes custom HTML tag selection.
  • Advanced Multi-Language System: Auto-detects visitor language from 42+ options with smart fallback support.
  • Visual Prompt Builder: A professional-grade wizard to build complex prompts step-by-step. Choose your target audience, writing style, tone, and goals with a live preview.

🛍️ AI Shop Assistant (Chatbot)

Transform your visitor experience with a store-aware AI agent. Unlike standard support bots, this assistant is integrated with your WooCommerce catalog and features a modern interface.
* Mobile-First Design: Features a tabbed layout (“Home” & “Messages”) and collapsible product cards, providing an optimal experience on all devices.
* Knowledge Pages: Teach your chatbot beyond just products by indexing specific store pages (e.g., About Us, Shipping Guides, FAQs).
* WhatsApp Integration: Includes a direct “Chat on WhatsApp” button.
* Store Policy & Context: Define your store’s context (shipping, returns, brand voice).
* Intelligent Message Queue: If the AI cannot reply for any reason, messages are instantly saved to the admin panel.
* Full Customization (Free): Customize Bot Name, Greeting Message, Launcher Icon (presets), Profile Picture, Animations, Colors, Typography, and Position.
* Pro Customization & Themes: (Pro) users gain access to Chatbot Themes, can rename/translate all UI text labels, and upload Custom Hero Background images.
* Optimized Performance: Uses server-side language detection to minimize frontend payload size.
* Product Recommendations: Displays “View Product” buttons for recommended items based on user queries.
* Visibility Control: Option to hide on specific WooCommerce pages or devices.
* Advanced Actions: “Add to Cart” button directly in chat and Custom Icon Uploads are available in (Pro).

📦 AI Store Indexing Technology

To ensure the Chatbot provides accurate recommendations, the plugin uses a native indexing system that creates a compressed “knowledge base” of your products. Optimized for massive catalogs with advanced shard handling.

  • Smart Cataloging: Scans and indexes standard product data (Titles, Prices, Short Descriptions, Categories, Stock Status).
  • Performance Focused: Uses data compression (GZIP) and batch processing to handle large catalogs efficiently.
  • Filtering: Configure Date Filters and Stock Status filters to control which products are indexed.
  • Advanced Data: Indexing of SKU, Full Descriptions, Tags, Attributes, and Stock Quantity is available in (Pro).
  • Automation: Scheduled Automatic Index Updates and Multi-Index Profiles are available in (Pro).

🚀 AI Automation Jobs

Transform manual work into automated workflows using the built-in job scheduler.

  • Set & Forget: Configure your prompt settings and start the bulk process.
  • Smart Filtering: Filter by price range and specific product IDs. Supports AND/OR logic for precise targeting.
  • Resilient State Management: Tracks job status with auto-resume functionality.
  • Real-time Monitoring: View accurate progress bars and estimated completion times.
  • Cost Control: Options to auto-pause generation to manage API usage effectively.
  • Safety: Automatic Content Backup before generation (Pro).
  • Advanced Filtering: Filter by category, stock status, product status, and tags (Pro).

⚡ Dual Bulk Description System

The toolkit offers two distinct bulk modes for product descriptions:

1. Standard Bulk Generator (Basic)
* Unlimited usage. Note: AI provider API usage (tokens) is billed separately by your chosen provider.
* Generates clean, plain text output.
* Smart Retry: If a generation fails, click “Retry” on that specific product without restarting the entire bulk job.
* Fast and efficient for simple bulk operations.
* Full Content Preview: Review generated text instantly before saving.
* Supports Tone/Style settings and Custom Prompts.

2. Advanced Bulk Generator (Professional)
* Rich Output: Generates HTML content with structured markup.
* Optimization Requests vs. Tokens: Advanced generation uses our proprietary AI Smart Parameters™ technology, consuming Optimization Requests. AI provider API usage (tokens) is billed separately by your chosen provider.
* Smart Retry: If a generation fails, click “Retry” on that specific product without restarting the entire bulk job.
* AI Smart Parameters™: Automatically configures model settings based on content type.
* Custom Fields Integration: Map existing custom fields to variables (e.g., {custom1}).
* Edit Before Approve: Review and modify content in bulk before it goes live.
* Content Improvement: Option to enhance existing descriptions (rewrite/expand) rather than overwriting them.

🎯 Specialized Bulk Tools

Bulk AI Image Alt Generator (New)
Automatically generate highly descriptive, SEO-optimized alt text for your WooCommerce product images using advanced AI Vision models.
* Vision AI Powered: Understands the content of your product images to create accurate descriptions.
* Review & Apply Workflow: Select products, generate, preview, edit, regenerate, or dismiss alt text before publishing.
* Advanced Workflows: Tone guidance, custom templates, A/B variants, and attribute-aware prompt enrichment (Pro).

Bulk AI Taxonomy Generator
Enhance your store’s SEO and navigation by bulk generating context-aware descriptions for categories, tags, and custom taxonomies.
* Smart Context Gathering: The AI analyzes product names, price ranges, tags, and existing descriptions within the taxonomy to create highly relevant, data-driven content.
* Split-Panel Interface: Navigate seamlessly with a draggable split-screen workspace featuring your term list on the left and a review/settings panel on the right.
* Rich Text Editing: Review and refine the generated descriptions using the built-in rich text editor before applying them.
* Write Modes: Choose between overwriting existing taxonomy descriptions or appending the new AI-generated content to the end.
* Session Persistence: Your generated results are safely preserved even if you refresh the page.
* Advanced Context Sources: Utilize full product descriptions and custom attributes as reference context for richer category descriptions (Pro).
* Custom Purpose & Prompts: Define Custom Purposes and add Additional Prompt instructions to guide the AI, with the ability to set global prompt templates (Pro).
* Adjustable Context Limits: Control the exact number of product samples the AI analyzes per term (up to 20) (Pro).

Bulk AI SEO Meta Generator
Enhance search visibility with AI-generated SEO titles and descriptions. Seamlessly integrates with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, The SEO Framework, and Squirrly SEO.
* Live SERP Preview: Visualize exactly how your product will look on search engines before publishing.
* SEO Scoring: Built-in analysis provides optimization suggestions and scores.
* Focus Keywords: Incorporate focus keywords for relevance.
* Smart Length Constraints: Ensures content fits within pixel limits.
* Bulk Workflow: Generate, review, and approve meta tags for thousands of products in clicks.

Bulk AI Product Title Generator
Create SEO-friendly product titles for thousands of products at once.
* Generation Mode: Default “Rewrite” mode using product data.
* Length Control: Set custom character or word limits.
* Tone Selection: Standard SEO-optimized tone.
* Data Sources: Uses product descriptions as the source.
* Advanced Modes: “Improve Title” mode and Specialized Tones (Professional, Urgent, Luxury) (Pro).
* Keyword Targeting: Enforce specific focus keywords in titles (Pro).
* Custom Sources: Custom data source integration (Pro).
* Customization: Additional System Prompt options (Pro).

Bulk AI Product FAQ Generator
Automatically generate and beautifully display Questions and Answers based on your product data.
* Automatic Display: Instantly show generated FAQs on your WooCommerce product pages in a sleek accordion format.
* Live Customizer: Choose from 6 ready-made themes (Minimal, Bordered, Dark, Elegant, etc.) and customize colors, typography, borders, and icons with real-time live preview.
* SEO Schema Markup: Automatically adds proper FAQPage Schema.org structured data to your products for Google rich snippets.
* Shortcode Support: Use [aipt_faq] to place FAQs anywhere on your site, or target specific products using [aipt_faq product_id="123"].
* Output: Generates complete “Question + Answer” pairs stored safely in structured meta fields.
* Quantity Control: Set custom number of FAQs per product.
* Contextual Analysis: Uses product descriptions as the reference source.
* Advanced Modes: Separate “Question Only” / “Answer Only” modes and “Rewrite” mode (Pro).
* Advanced Context: Advanced source selection (Pro).
* Custom Targeting: Saving to specific Custom Fields (Pro).
* Customization: Additional System Prompt options (Pro).

Bulk Smart Product Tag Generation
Analyze product data to generate relevant tags for better internal search and discoverability. (Includes bulk generation)

🛠 Toolkit Dashboard & Integration

Centralized Control Center & Insights (New)
Access all tools (Automation, Bulk Generators, Title, FAQ, SEO, Taxonomies) from a single dashboard. Includes new Dashboard Insights cards for recent activity, usage statistics, and real-time AI provider status for quick reviews.

Settings Command Palette (New)
Navigate settings blazingly fast. Use the searchable command palette in Settings to instantly jump to provider, prompt, or feature configuration sections.

Prompt Management & Hub (New)
A brand new centralized tab to manage your entire prompt workflow. Use the Visual Prompt Builder to create templates, browse the Community Prompt Library (Pro), or use AI Auto-Fill to optimize your existing custom prompts. Includes seamless integration with the single product metabox and automation screens.

Large Catalog Support
Includes a custom pagination system allowing users to jump to any page instantly and control the number of products displayed per page (10, 25, 50, 100+).

Acknowledgments

Thank you for choosing AI Product Tools to enhance your WooCommerce store with AI-powered solutions. We appreciate your trust in us and are committed to helping you streamline your workflow.

🔒 Privacy & Third-Party Services

This plugin utilizes external services to provide AI content generation and chatbot features.

1. AI Content Providers (Bring Your Own Key)
You must connect your own API key to use this plugin (either locally or centrally via the WordPress AI Connectors system). Product data, images (for Alt text), and chat messages are sent directly to your selected provider. API provider API usage (tokens) is billed by your chosen AI provider and is not included in the plugin subscription.
* OpenAI: Terms | Privacy
* Google Gemini: Terms | Privacy
* Anthropic Claude: Terms | Privacy
* OpenRouter: Terms | Privacy

2. AI Smart Parameters™ (Advanced Generator Only)
Connects to our external service to optimize AI generation settings.
* Data Sent: Site URL, admin email, plugin version, and usage statistics.
* Policies: Our Privacy Policy | Terms

Security Note: Your third-party API keys are stored encrypted locally in your WordPress database or managed safely by the WordPress Connectors system and are never shared with us.
sections.installation:
1. Upload ‘ai-product-tools.zip’ to your ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  2. Activate AI Product Tools from the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Complete the onboarding wizard by selecting your preferred AI provider (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude or OpenRouter) and entering your API key. Alternatively, connect via WordPress AI Connectors.
  4. Visit the Toolkit Dashboard to explore available tools
  5. Customize your prompt settings and generation preferences
  6. Start using the plugin to generate and enhance your product content
sections.faq:
Is AI Product Tools free to use?

The plugin offers extensive functionality in the free version:
* AI Shop Assistant: Free chatbot with full appearance customization, multi-language support, and product recommendations (View Product button).
* Standard Bulk Generator: Unlimited plugin usage.
* Title, FAQ & SEO Generators: Free generation with standard settings.
* Automation Jobs: Free scheduling with basic filtering.
Pro plans unlock advanced chatbot features (“Add to Cart” button, Custom CSS, Scheduled Indexing, Chatbot Themes), advanced bulk generation, Community Prompt Library, and more. (Remember: Provider API tokens are billed separately).

Do I have to pay for AI API usage? (Bring Your Own Key)

Yes. We deliberately chose a “Bring Your Own Key” (BYOK) model to give you complete freedom. This means you connect your own API key (locally or via WP Connectors) and pay the provider directly for the tokens you use. This ensures you get the lowest wholesale pricing with zero markup from us and you can switch between AI providers anytime. Alternatively, you can connect OpenRouter to access various 100% free AI models.

What is the difference between Optimization Requests and API Tokens?

To ensure absolute clarity:
* API Tokens: You pay your chosen AI provider (OpenAI, Claude, etc.) directly for the raw AI processing.
* Optimization Requests: The “Optimization Requests” (e.g., 5,000/month or Unlimited) in our premium plans are exclusively for our proprietary AI Smart Parameters™ service. This service optimizes your prompt parameters before sending them to the AI to ensure high-quality HTML output.
Note: Business plans with “Unlimited Optimization Requests” are subject to a standard fair use policy to prevent automated abuse.

How does the Image Alt Generator work?

It utilizes advanced AI Vision models (like GPT-4o or Gemini Flash) to “see” your product images and generate accurate, SEO-friendly alternative text for accessibility and search engine ranking.

Does the Chatbot slow down my site?

No. It utilizes an efficient server-side language detection system that reduces the frontend payload. It loads asynchronously and uses a compressed index structure (GZIP).

Can I edit content before publishing?

Yes. All generation tools (Standard, Advanced, Title, FAQ, SEO, and Taxonomies) include an “Edit Before Approve” workflow. This allows you to review, modify, and polish the AI-generated content in bulk before saving it to your live products.

Can I keep my images when the AI rewrites a description?

Yes! With the “Preserve Existing Images” setting enabled, the AI will only modify the text content while keeping all <img> tags and their original positions exactly where they are.

Can I customize the Chatbot’s appearance?

Yes. The free version allows extensive customization including Bot Name, Welcome Message, Colors, Typography, Position, and built-in Launcher Icons. The Pro version unlocks advanced visual controls, including Chatbot Themes, Custom Hero Background images, Custom Icon uploads, and the ability to rename or translate all UI text labels.

How does the AI Chatbot know about my products?

The plugin uses the AI Store Index feature. It scans your product titles, prices, categories, and stock status to create a compressed data file. The AI uses this index to find and recommend relevant products during a conversation.

What is the Visual Prompt Builder?

It is a full-screen wizard that guides you through the prompt creation process. Instead of writing long technical instructions, you simply select your preferences (e.g., “Urgent” tone, “Tech Savvy” audience), and the plugin builds the perfect prompt for you.

What is the difference between Standard and Advanced Generators?

  • Standard: Unlimited usage, plain text output, supports tone settings and custom prompts. Ideal for quick, simple descriptions.
  • Advanced: Generates HTML content with structured markup. It features custom fields integration, history tracking, content improvement mode, and utilizes the external AI Smart Parameters™ system for automatic optimization (consumes Optimization Requests).

How do Custom Fields work?

You can map existing WooCommerce custom fields (compatible with Advanced Custom Fields / ACF plugin) to variables like {custom1}. These variables can be inserted into your prompt templates, allowing the AI to include specific data points (materials, dimensions, internal codes) in the generated text. Note: Custom Field mapping is available in Advanced Generator, Title, and FAQ tools.

How does the AI Smart Parameters™ technology work?

Available in the Advanced Generator, this external optimization service automatically configures technical AI settings (temperature, top_p, presence penalty) based on the specific model and content type being generated. This eliminates the need for manual configuration.

Does this plugin work with large catalogs?

Yes. The plugin includes a custom pagination system for navigating thousands of products and uses WP-Cron for background processing. This prevents server timeouts and ensures stability even when processing massive product lists.

What is OpenRouter and why should I use it?

OpenRouter is an AI gateway that allows you to access hundreds of models beyond just OpenAI. It includes many free-to-use models (like Qwen, DeepSeek, Llama, Mistral, etc.) which allow you to generate content at zero cost. It also supports premium models like Claude Sonnet and Grok. You can connect your OpenRouter key directly in the plugin settings.

Is my data secure?

Yes. We prioritize security:
1. Local Storage: API keys are encrypted in your database.
2. Direct Transmission: Data goes directly to the AI Provider (OpenAI, Gemini, etc.).
3. Zero Access: We do not have access to your product content or chat logs.
sections.changelog:
2.6.5

  • NEW: Catalog Visibility Filtering — You can now granularly filter your products by their catalog visibility status (e.g., hidden, search/shop only) when setting up bulk generation jobs.
  • IMPROVED: Revamped Settings Hub & Command Palette — The settings area has been completely redesigned with a modern card-based layout. Use the new Command Palette (⌘K / Ctrl+K) for lightning-fast navigation across all options.
  • IMPROVED: Prompt Formatting Preservation — Paragraph breaks and line spacing inside your custom prompt textareas are now perfectly preserved instead of being stripped out.
  • IMPROVED: Streamlined Onboarding — Enhanced detection logic for WordPress AI Connectors ensures a smoother, friction-free initial setup for new users.
  • IMPROVED: UI Workflow Polish — Realigned the “Bulk Generate” button to match the width of generation settings for a cleaner flow, and replaced the “Feature Request” button with “Report Bug” on the dashboard for quicker support routing.
  • FIXED: Massive UI Stability Update — Squashed 76 verified UI bugs! Resolved race conditions overwriting results, fixed “select all” checkbox anomalies on paginated lists, and corrected row update mismatches in the Image Alt generator.
  • FIXED: Automation & Chatbot Reliability — Prevented jobs from getting permanently stuck in “pending” during low-credit scenarios, blocked double-application of drafts, and fixed a critical crash in SEO Meta duplicate checking.
  • SECURITY: Zero-Exposure API Keys — Saved API keys are strictly masked (••••) and are no longer sent to the browser payload. Updating a key requires a fresh input, eliminating accidental exposure or overwriting.
  • SECURITY: Hardened Permission Checks — Patched a vulnerability allowing free users to access premium FAQ options, tightened SEO Meta endpoint permissions, redacted sensitive information from AI provider error logs, and added a safe-abort mechanism if content backup fails.

  • FIXED: Title Generator Keyboard Focus Reconciliation — When the focused row is filtered out (via search or filter) or scrolled off the visible page, the Space / a / r / e keyboard shortcuts no longer act on the now-hidden row. Focus moves to the first visible product instead.

Customers who relied on the visible page selection no longer accidentally queue thousands of products for generation. The dedicated “Select all N matching” affordance in the selection strip remains the explicit opt-in for catalog-wide selection.
  • FIXED: Inspector panel per-product Generate button now stays clickable under the same conditions as the bulk Generate CTA (parity restored).
  • FIXED: Aborting a bulk Description generation preserves rows that already completed instead of resetting them.
  • FIXED: WP Connectors-managed credentials are now correctly detected even when the aiptData.settings localization payload is missing, eliminating a rare false-negative provider warning.
  • IMPROVED: Automation Jobs “New Job” wizard confirms before discarding dirty form state; step-pill clicks surface validation feedback instead of silently jumping between steps.
  • IMPROVED: Taxonomy Generator confirms before discarding generated results when switching taxonomies.

short_description: All-in-One AI Suite for WooCommerce: Generate product descriptions, titles, tags, FAQs, alt text, SEO meta & chatbot via top AI models.
description:
AI Product Tools is a comprehensive AI suite designed to automate your WooCommerce operations and enhance customer experience. It combines high-volume bulk product content generation with a store-aware AI Shop Assistant, providing a complete infrastructure for both backend management and frontend sales support.

The plugin offers versatile workflows to suit any store management style:
* AI Bulk Product Content Generators: Trigger mass updates for Descriptions, Titles, Tags, Taxonomies, FAQs, and Image Alt Text.
* AI Bulk SEO Meta Generator: Support your search visibility with AI-generated Meta Titles & Descriptions compatible with major SEO plugins.
* AI Shop Assistant (Chatbot): A 24/7 intelligent sales agent that uses your catalog and store policies to assist visitors.
* Automation Jobs: Schedule automated background tasks (“set and forget”).
* Single Product Metabox: Fine-tune content directly inside the WooCommerce edit screen.
* Visual Prompt Builder: Stop guessing how to write prompts. Build them visually step-by-step with a real-time preview of your configuration.

It integrates seamlessly with leading AI providers, giving you full control over model selection (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, OpenRouter), prompts, and generation strategies. Supports centralized API credential management via WordPress AI Connectors.

🤖 Key Features

  • WordPress AI Connectors Integration (New): Connect via the native WordPress AI Connectors system. Manage provider credentials centrally instead of storing them locally within the plugin, featuring a live status panel and guided migration.
  • AI Bulk Image Alt Generator (New): Scan and generate context-aware alt text for product images. Review, edit, regenerate, or dismiss before applying changes.
  • Dashboard Insights (New): High-level dashboard cards tracking recent automation activity, exact usage statistics, and real-time AI provider connectivity status.
  • Searchable Command Palette (New): Instantly navigate through complex provider settings, prompt hubs, and feature configurations inside the Settings panel.
  • WordPress 7.0 Abilities API & MCP Support: Fully compatible with WordPress 7.0 core abilities and Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients for native tool-calling automation.
  • AI Shop Assistant: An intelligent chatbot with a mobile-first tabbed interface that answers queries, recommends products, and integrates with WhatsApp.
  • AI Bulk SEO Generator: Generate optimized Meta Titles & Descriptions for Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO, and more.
  • Smart FAQ Display System: Automatically display generated FAQs on product pages with customizable themes, accordion animations, and built-in SEO Schema markup.
  • Resilient Generation & Retry: Never restart a bulk job due to a single error. Easily retry failed generations on a per-product basis with one click.
  • Prompt Management: Create, save, and reuse custom Prompt Templates, or discover and import optimized prompts from the Community Prompt Library (Pro).
  • AI Brand Voice: Define your store’s persona and tone settings globally to ensure the AI writes in your brand’s unique voice.
  • Example Content Learning: Paste an example of your preferred product description, and the AI will mimic its structure and style (Pro).
  • Unified AI Dashboard: Centralized control center featuring new Dashboard Insights (recent activity, usage stats) to manage all generation tools.
  • Mass Product Content Generation: Bulk process Descriptions, Titles, Tags, Taxonomies, FAQs, Image Alt Text, and SEO Metadata for thousands of products.
  • Multi-Provider Support: Connect with leading AI models including OpenAI (GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-4.1, O3/O4), Google Gemini (3.5 Flash, 3.1 Pro, 2.5), Anthropic Claude (Opus 4.7, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5), and OpenRouter (300+ models).
  • Smart Context Analysis: The AI analyzes product categories, attributes, prices, and stock status to create factual, relevant content.
  • SEO & HTML Formatting: Automatically structures content with HTML markup and keywords. Includes custom HTML tag selection.
  • Advanced Multi-Language System: Auto-detects visitor language from 42+ options with smart fallback support.
  • Visual Prompt Builder: A professional-grade wizard to build complex prompts step-by-step. Choose your target audience, writing style, tone, and goals with a live preview.

🛍️ AI Shop Assistant (Chatbot)

Transform your visitor experience with a store-aware AI agent. Unlike standard support bots, this assistant is integrated with your WooCommerce catalog and features a modern interface.
* Mobile-First Design: Features a tabbed layout (“Home” & “Messages”) and collapsible product cards, providing an optimal experience on all devices.
* Knowledge Pages: Teach your chatbot beyond just products by indexing specific store pages (e.g., About Us, Shipping Guides, FAQs).
* WhatsApp Integration: Includes a direct “Chat on WhatsApp” button.
* Store Policy & Context: Define your store’s context (shipping, returns, brand voice).
* Intelligent Message Queue: If the AI cannot reply for any reason, messages are instantly saved to the admin panel.
* Full Customization (Free): Customize Bot Name, Greeting Message, Launcher Icon (presets), Profile Picture, Animations, Colors, Typography, and Position.
* Pro Customization & Themes: (Pro) users gain access to Chatbot Themes, can rename/translate all UI text labels, and upload Custom Hero Background images.
* Optimized Performance: Uses server-side language detection to minimize frontend payload size.
* Product Recommendations: Displays “View Product” buttons for recommended items based on user queries.
* Visibility Control: Option to hide on specific WooCommerce pages or devices.
* Advanced Actions: “Add to Cart” button directly in chat and Custom Icon Uploads are available in (Pro).

📦 AI Store Indexing Technology

To ensure the Chatbot provides accurate recommendations, the plugin uses a native indexing system that creates a compressed “knowledge base” of your products. Optimized for massive catalogs with advanced shard handling.

  • Smart Cataloging: Scans and indexes standard product data (Titles, Prices, Short Descriptions, Categories, Stock Status).
  • Performance Focused: Uses data compression (GZIP) and batch processing to handle large catalogs efficiently.
  • Filtering: Configure Date Filters and Stock Status filters to control which products are indexed.
  • Advanced Data: Indexing of SKU, Full Descriptions, Tags, Attributes, and Stock Quantity is available in (Pro).
  • Automation: Scheduled Automatic Index Updates and Multi-Index Profiles are available in (Pro).

🚀 AI Automation Jobs

Transform manual work into automated workflows using the built-in job scheduler.

  • Set & Forget: Configure your prompt settings and start the bulk process.
  • Smart Filtering: Filter by price range and specific product IDs. Supports AND/OR logic for precise targeting.
  • Resilient State Management: Tracks job status with auto-resume functionality.
  • Real-time Monitoring: View accurate progress bars and estimated completion times.
  • Cost Control: Options to auto-pause generation to manage API usage effectively.
  • Safety: Automatic Content Backup before generation (Pro).
  • Advanced Filtering: Filter by category, stock status, product status, and tags (Pro).

⚡ Dual Bulk Description System

The toolkit offers two distinct bulk modes for product descriptions:

1. Standard Bulk Generator (Basic)
* Unlimited usage. Note: AI provider API usage (tokens) is billed separately by your chosen provider.
* Generates clean, plain text output.
* Smart Retry: If a generation fails, click “Retry” on that specific product without restarting the entire bulk job.
* Fast and efficient for simple bulk operations.
* Full Content Preview: Review generated text instantly before saving.
* Supports Tone/Style settings and Custom Prompts.

2. Advanced Bulk Generator (Professional)
* Rich Output: Generates HTML content with structured markup.
* Optimization Requests vs. Tokens: Advanced generation uses our proprietary AI Smart Parameters™ technology, consuming Optimization Requests. AI provider API usage (tokens) is billed separately by your chosen provider.
* Smart Retry: If a generation fails, click “Retry” on that specific product without restarting the entire bulk job.
* AI Smart Parameters™: Automatically configures model settings based on content type.
* Custom Fields Integration: Map existing custom fields to variables (e.g., {custom1}).
* Edit Before Approve: Review and modify content in bulk before it goes live.
* Content Improvement: Option to enhance existing descriptions (rewrite/expand) rather than overwriting them.

🎯 Specialized Bulk Tools

Bulk AI Image Alt Generator (New)
Automatically generate highly descriptive, SEO-optimized alt text for your WooCommerce product images using advanced AI Vision models.
* Vision AI Powered: Understands the content of your product images to create accurate descriptions.
* Review & Apply Workflow: Select products, generate, preview, edit, regenerate, or dismiss alt text before publishing.
* Advanced Workflows: Tone guidance, custom templates, A/B variants, and attribute-aware prompt enrichment (Pro).

Bulk AI Taxonomy Generator
Enhance your store’s SEO and navigation by bulk generating context-aware descriptions for categories, tags, and custom taxonomies.
* Smart Context Gathering: The AI analyzes product names, price ranges, tags, and existing descriptions within the taxonomy to create highly relevant, data-driven content.
* Split-Panel Interface: Navigate seamlessly with a draggable split-screen workspace featuring your term list on the left and a review/settings panel on the right.
* Rich Text Editing: Review and refine the generated descriptions using the built-in rich text editor before applying them.
* Write Modes: Choose between overwriting existing taxonomy descriptions or appending the new AI-generated content to the end.
* Session Persistence: Your generated results are safely preserved even if you refresh the page.
* Advanced Context Sources: Utilize full product descriptions and custom attributes as reference context for richer category descriptions (Pro).
* Custom Purpose & Prompts: Define Custom Purposes and add Additional Prompt instructions to guide the AI, with the ability to set global prompt templates (Pro).
* Adjustable Context Limits: Control the exact number of product samples the AI analyzes per term (up to 20) (Pro).

Bulk AI SEO Meta Generator
Enhance search visibility with AI-generated SEO titles and descriptions. Seamlessly integrates with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, The SEO Framework, and Squirrly SEO.
* Live SERP Preview: Visualize exactly how your product will look on search engines before publishing.
* SEO Scoring: Built-in analysis provides optimization suggestions and scores.
* Focus Keywords: Incorporate focus keywords for relevance.
* Smart Length Constraints: Ensures content fits within pixel limits.
* Bulk Workflow: Generate, review, and approve meta tags for thousands of products in clicks.

Bulk AI Product Title Generator
Create SEO-friendly product titles for thousands of products at once.
* Generation Mode: Default “Rewrite” mode using product data.
* Length Control: Set custom character or word limits.
* Tone Selection: Standard SEO-optimized tone.
* Data Sources: Uses product descriptions as the source.
* Advanced Modes: “Improve Title” mode and Specialized Tones (Professional, Urgent, Luxury) (Pro).
* Keyword Targeting: Enforce specific focus keywords in titles (Pro).
* Custom Sources: Custom data source integration (Pro).
* Customization: Additional System Prompt options (Pro).

Bulk AI Product FAQ Generator
Automatically generate and beautifully display Questions and Answers based on your product data.
* Automatic Display: Instantly show generated FAQs on your WooCommerce product pages in a sleek accordion format.
* Live Customizer: Choose from 6 ready-made themes (Minimal, Bordered, Dark, Elegant, etc.) and customize colors, typography, borders, and icons with real-time live preview.
* SEO Schema Markup: Automatically adds proper FAQPage Schema.org structured data to your products for Google rich snippets.
* Shortcode Support: Use [aipt_faq] to place FAQs anywhere on your site, or target specific products using [aipt_faq product_id="123"].
* Output: Generates complete “Question + Answer” pairs stored safely in structured meta fields.
* Quantity Control: Set custom number of FAQs per product.
* Contextual Analysis: Uses product descriptions as the reference source.
* Advanced Modes: Separate “Question Only” / “Answer Only” modes and “Rewrite” mode (Pro).
* Advanced Context: Advanced source selection (Pro).
* Custom Targeting: Saving to specific Custom Fields (Pro).
* Customization: Additional System Prompt options (Pro).

Bulk Smart Product Tag Generation
Analyze product data to generate relevant tags for better internal search and discoverability. (Includes bulk generation)

🛠 Toolkit Dashboard & Integration

Centralized Control Center & Insights (New)
Access all tools (Automation, Bulk Generators, Title, FAQ, SEO, Taxonomies) from a single dashboard. Includes new Dashboard Insights cards for recent activity, usage statistics, and real-time AI provider status for quick reviews.

Settings Command Palette (New)
Navigate settings blazingly fast. Use the searchable command palette in Settings to instantly jump to provider, prompt, or feature configuration sections.

Prompt Management & Hub (New)
A brand new centralized tab to manage your entire prompt workflow. Use the Visual Prompt Builder to create templates, browse the Community Prompt Library (Pro), or use AI Auto-Fill to optimize your existing custom prompts. Includes seamless integration with the single product metabox and automation screens.

Large Catalog Support
Includes a custom pagination system allowing users to jump to any page instantly and control the number of products displayed per page (10, 25, 50, 100+).

Acknowledgments

Thank you for choosing AI Product Tools to enhance your WooCommerce store with AI-powered solutions. We appreciate your trust in us and are committed to helping you streamline your workflow.

🔒 Privacy & Third-Party Services

This plugin utilizes external services to provide AI content generation and chatbot features.

1. AI Content Providers (Bring Your Own Key)
You must connect your own API key to use this plugin (either locally or centrally via the WordPress AI Connectors system). Product data, images (for Alt text), and chat messages are sent directly to your selected provider. API provider API usage (tokens) is billed by your chosen AI provider and is not included in the plugin subscription.
* OpenAI: Terms | Privacy
* Google Gemini: Terms | Privacy
* Anthropic Claude: Terms | Privacy
* OpenRouter: Terms | Privacy

2. AI Smart Parameters™ (Advanced Generator Only)
Connects to our external service to optimize AI generation settings.
* Data Sent: Site URL, admin email, plugin version, and usage statistics.
* Policies: Our Privacy Policy | Terms

Security Note: Your third-party API keys are stored encrypted locally in your WordPress database or managed safely by the WordPress Connectors system and are never shared with us.
